prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Miami after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
Below are several Miami-area personal injury firms you can call after a car accident, with why each is worth contacting and what to ask when you call. I’m not endorsing any single firm — verify current contact info, reviews, and disciplinary records before hiring.

Top firms to call

- Podhurst Orseck, P.A. (Miami)
  - Why call: Long-established Miami plaintiffs’ firm with extensive experience in catastrophic car-crash cases, high-value settlements and jury verdicts, and trial experience if insurance won’t settle.
  - Best when: Serious injuries, permanent disability, or wrongful death.

- Colson Hicks Eidson (Miami)
  - Why call: Strong record in wrongful-death and catastrophic-injury cases, experienced trial attorneys, and frequent work on complex injury matters arising from auto collisions.
  - Best when: Complex liability issues, severe injuries, or multi-party crashes.

- Morgan & Morgan (Miami office)
  - Why call: Large national plaintiffs’ firm with substantial resources, wide experience in auto-accident claims, and a high volume of cases (easier to get quick intake and investigations).
  - Best when: You want a nationally resourced firm and prompt case intake.

- Steinger, Greene & Feiner (Florida offices, including South Florida)
  - Why call: Florida-focused personal injury firm that handles auto accidents aggressively on contingency; often handles more routine and moderately severe car-accident claims.
  - Best when: Straightforward injuries where you want active local representation.

- Anidjar & Levine (Florida / Miami)
  - Why call: Personal-injury practice with Miami presence, known for car-accident representation and contingency-fee arrangements and free consultations.
  - Best when: You want a firm focused on accident claims across Florida with local availability.

- Kanner & Pintaluga (serving Miami area)
  - Why call: Florida plaintiffs’ firm with experience in auto crashes, wrongful death and catastrophic injury, known for trial experience in high-stakes cases.
  - Best when: More severe claims or when you want a firm experienced at taking cases to trial.

How to choose which to hire (questions to ask on the call)
- Do you handle car-accident cases in Miami–Dade County? How many per year?
- Have you handled cases like mine (severity, seatbelt/no seatbelt, multi-car, uninsured motorist)? Examples/outcomes?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day — an attorney or paralegal? Can I meet the attorney who will be responsible?
- Do you take cases on contingency? What is your fee and what costs are deducted from the recovery?
- What is your approach to settlement vs. trial? How long do cases like mine usually take?
- Are you licensed and in good standing with The Florida Bar? Any disciplinary history?
- Can you provide recent client references or online reviews?

Practical next steps right now
- Seek medical care and keep records.
- Get or keep the police report number, insurance info, photos, and contact info of witnesses.
- Take notes about symptoms and how the crash happened.
- Call 2–3 firms above for free consultations, compare answers on experience, fees, and comfort level, and pick the one you trust.

If you want, tell me:
- Date of the crash, injury severity, whether the police/insurance have been contacted, and whether you’re already seeing a doctor — I can help prioritize which type of firm to contact first and suggest specific initial questions tailored to your case.
